note: Read 2026-11-04 (layer 4's research on a series and a play in every market, item 7): the US stage director's minimums, the SDC's. A US screen director's terms are the DGA's, which the engine keeps itself (R-4613), so this file holds the stage alone. Both rate sheets are scans: each figure was read on the page image by the integrator.

figures.finding: A director of a dramatic production on Broadway under the SDC's Minimum Basic Agreement with the Broadway League is owed at least a fee of USD 40,124 and an advance of 30,426, USD 70,550 in all, from 2 March 2026 to 28 February 2027; the royalties (1.5% of gross, a share of net operating profits) aren't held, the game keeping no box office.

value.agreement: SDC-Broadway League Minimum Basic Agreement, Director & Choreographer-Broadway rate schedule

figures.applies: United States, first-class (Broadway) dramatic productions, 2 March 2026 to 28 February 2027.

sources.said: Director & Choreographer-Broadway Minimum Basic Agreement Rate Schedule March 2, 2026 – February 28, 2027 … Category Director … Dramatic Production Fee $40,124 Advance $30,426 Total $70,550

figures.finding: A director at a LORT (resident non-profit) theatre under the SDC's agreement is owed at least the category's minimum fee for its minimum period of employment, from 15 April 2026 to 14 April 2027: A+ USD 37,984, A 29,236, B+ 24,230, B 20,184, C-1 16,601, C-2 11,036, D 8,963. Each day past the minimum period (A+ 656 to D 233, a full week six days) isn't held, the engine counting a week as five days; a protected theatre's discount isn't published.
